lines.text: Three animals that actually rob humans.
First, seagulls. They don't just grab any food.
In one experiment, gulls watched a person pick up one of two snacks, and they went straight for the one the human had touched.
They watch what you eat, and they want that.
Next, the kea, a parrot from New Zealand.
It rips the rubber off car windows, pulls off windshield wipers, and unzips backpacks to see what's inside.
It got so bad that people built them a playground, just to keep them away from the cars.
Finally, the monkeys at Uluwatu Temple in Bali.
They snatch tourists' phones, glasses and hats, and then they wait.
Because they'll only give it back for food.
And scientists found the more valuable the thing they steal, the more food they hold out for.
